rationale: The agent canceled order #W3361211 without first authenticating the user or verifying ownership via the provided tools. There is no evidence of confirmation from the user prior to performing the write (cancellation), which violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user's stated goal was to change the luggage set to a coat, return the item only if a change wasn’t possible, and cancel the whole order only if there were issues; the agent jumped directly to cancellation with the reason “no longer needed” without attempting a modification or return or documenting any issues. The final message claims cancellation was “as requested,” which is inaccurate given the user’s instructions. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
